revisedMode: Default reoptimize with skipProvenOptimal=true; validate remaining route before bound test.
controls: Reuse all 30 archived edited maps, current starts, goals, prior routes and order. No new sampling, wall choice, prior-route acquisition or reference search. Run both policy arms anew under current source; compare original baseline output fields to the immutable archive.
measurements: Returned path/length/validity, bound proofs versus A* completions, planner calls/expansions per arm, equality to archived BFS distances, budget failures and original-field compatibility. Count fresh rerun costs separately; zero planner work does not mean zero validation work.
attribution: Student selected option 1 to adopt the AI-proposed skip rule after seeing the original cohort. No independent algorithm invention, code/test authorship, numerical forecast or operation inferred. AI supplies implementation, controls, execution and analysis.
scope: Replay on the same development cohort that motivated the rule, not held-out validation, an independent new cohort or a physical robot result. Rule is restricted to valid paths in known static four-neighbor unit-cost grids.
